end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting lines, and sorting straight from curved lines. They explained that a standing line is upright, a sleeping line lies flat, and a slanting line is tilted; they also used the large T to identify its top and bottom lines. One mix-up remained about whether a line that changes direction can be called straight; revisit this by tracing straight and curved examples at home.
